findings.title: The count as an allotted interval
findings.claim: Where the clause could read as “We are tallying their deeds or persons,” its focus contact also allows the attributed addition “We are counting out their allotted interval to completion; the ban on haste preserves that measured term.”
findings.mechanism: The root occurrence taʿjal supplies the before-its-time trigger; naʿuddu and ʿaddan carry enumeration. Their contact permits the count to be heard as a bounded period being run through, and the fixed-time facet adds a possible endpoint without naming it.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear an allotted term being carried through inside the ordinary count.
findings.containment: The tally reading remains intact; this attributed alternative names no specific waiting period, recurring event, duration, endpoint, or counted item.
